Junior Astronaut – Mars Expedition

Project Overview

Junior Astronaut – Mars Expedition is an interactive 3D educational space exploration game designed to help students and young learners experience the challenges of exploring Mars. Players take the role of a junior astronaut and explore a simulated Martian environment while completing scientific missions.

What Does It Do and How Does It Work?

Players enter a 3D Mars environment and control an astronaut to explore the planet. They complete different missions, collect virtual rock and soil samples, manage limited oxygen supplies, and finish objectives within a given time.

The game includes:

  • A 3D Mars environment with terrain, craters and rocks.
  • Astronaut movement and interactive controls.
  • Sample collection and scientific exploration missions.
  • Oxygen management and mission countdown timer.
  • Points and scoring based on mission performance.
  • User interface, mission instructions and audio feedback.
  • Educational information about Mars and space exploration.

Benefits

  • Makes space science interesting and interactive.
  • Encourages students to learn about Mars through gameplay.
  • Develops problem-solving, decision-making and critical-thinking skills.
  • Introduces the challenges astronauts face during planetary exploration.
  • Promotes interest in science, technology and space research.

Intended Impact

Our goal is to inspire the next generation of space explorers, scientists and engineers. The project aims to make planetary science more accessible to students by transforming scientific learning into an engaging gaming experience.

It can help young learners understand the importance of scientific exploration, resource management, teamwork and mission planning.

Tools, Programming Languages and Software

Our development toolkit includes:

  • AI-assisted development: Google Antigravity.
  • Version control and collaboration: Git and GitHub.
  • Programming languages: HTML, CSS and JavaScript, depending on the implemented modules.
  • 3D development: Three.js, if used in the final build.
  • 3D asset creation: Blender, if used.
  • Testing: Browser-based gameplay testing and debugging.

Creativity and Innovation

The creative aspect of our project is combining Mars exploration, astronaut simulation and educational gameplay into one interactive experience.

Instead of simply reading about Mars, players experience a simulated mission where they must explore, collect samples, manage oxygen and complete objectives. The scoring system makes learning engaging and encourages players to improve their performance.

Factors Considered by Our Team

Our six-member team considered:

  1. Scientific accuracy of Mars-related educational information.
  2. Easy-to-understand controls for young players.
  3. Realistic-looking and engaging Mars environments.
  4. Oxygen limitations and time-based mission challenges.
  5. Smooth gameplay and performance across supported devices.
  6. Team collaboration, GitHub integration and code quality.
  7. Accessibility, educational value and presentation readiness.

Our Vision

Explore Mars. Discover Science. Inspire the Future.

Junior Astronaut – Mars Expedition aims to turn curiosity about space into an exciting learning adventure and inspire young minds to dream beyond Earth.
